observations: Photo 0 shows a single car headlight assembly with a clear lens and a yellow turn signal section.
The assembly has a black plastic housing with a visible mounting bracket on the right side.
There is a watermark 'HONDA AND ACURA POSTED ON JIJI' overlaid on the image.
The surface the headlight rests on is dusty and uneven, suggesting outdoor or workshop storage.
No visible damage to the lens or housing is apparent in this photo.

claims.claim: Body, engine and suspension parts for all model of honda, acura and toyota cars and suvs
claims.evidence: The photo shows only a headlight assembly, not parts from multiple vehicle types. The claim about 'body, engine, and suspension parts' cannot be verified from the single photo.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy. No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The headlight may be damaged internally or have cracked glass not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens and internal components, including the bulb socket and wiring harness.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially non-functional or damaged

risks.risk: The part may not fit the intended vehicle model, as the watermark suggests it is for Honda and Acura, but the seller claims it is for all Toyota models.
risks.proof: A photo showing the part installed on a vehicle or a clear view of the part's mounting points and model-specific markings.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly incompatible with the buyer's vehicle

risks.risk: The part may be a counterfeit or non-original replacement.
risks.proof: A photo of the part's serial number or OEM label, or a comparison with a known genuine part.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic or unbranded part

proof_requests: A close-up photo of the headlight's internal components and bulb socket.
A photo showing the part installed on a vehicle or a clear view of the mounting points and model-specific markings.
A photo of the part's serial number or OEM label if available.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
